اختلقتن (form VIII)
# اِخْتَلَقْتُنَّ (iḵtalaqtunna) /ix.ta.laq.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِخْتَلَقَ (iḵtalaqa)
# اُخْتُلِقْتُنَّ (uḵtuliqtunna) /ux.tu.liq.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِخْتَلَقَ (iḵtalaqa)
